story: Werner-Boyce Salt Springs State Park is a Florida state park located in Pasco County, Florida near Port Richey, Florida, along the Gulf of Mexico on the Atlantic coastal plain. The park is named, in part, for a 98 meters deep saltwater spring in the park.
matters: The park's wildlife include gray foxes, gopher tortoises, alligators, and West Indian manatees, as well as about 150 species of bird.
name: Werner-Boyce Salt Springs State Park
